'''AlderaanMotors''' was a manufacturing company producing [[Engine/Legends|engine]] arrays and [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]. AlderaanMotors products were used aboard [[Corellia StarDrive]]'s [[Coruscant-class Heavy Courier|''Coruscant''-class Heavy Courier]], such as [[Ulic Qel-Droma/Legends|Ulic Qel-Droma's]] ''[[Nebulon Ranger]]''.<ref name="EGVV" />
